interactions.note: The mAbs bound to the epitope. Alanine-scanning mutagenesis showed that substitutions F25A, D26A, V33A reduced binding of all four mAbs (CB2, 9.1, 2.1 and 11G9), as well as binding of BAFF (B-cell-activating factor belonging to the TNF family). The authors concluded that these mutations indirectly affected binding. Binding of CB2 was also reduced by substitutions L28A, V29A and R30A, which also reduced BAFF binding.
